messages.author: c47f732bf0f6ef00
messages.subject: Installation on Amazon EMR
parts:
Hi.

I'm freakin' working to install Rhipe on Amazon Elastic MapReduce with
no success so far. This environment looks like Ubuntu, but I'm not
sure which version it is. Here is a list what I did:

- I installed pkg-config using apt-get command.
- I installed google protobuf 2.3.0 as the instruction. Here are some
outputs from protobuf.

$ protoc --version
libprotoc 2.3.0

$ pkg-config --cflags protobuf
-pthread -I/usr/local/include

-Now, sudo R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.65.4.tar.gz fails with following
messages:

$ sudo R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.65.4.tar.gz
* Installing to library '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library'
* Installing *source* package 'Rhipe' ...
checking for gcc... gcc -std=gnu99
checking for C compiler default output file name... rm: cannot remove
`a.out.dSYM': Is a directory
a.out
checking whether the C compiler works... yes
checking whether we are cross compiling... no
checking for suffix of executables...
checking for suffix of object files... o
checking whether we are using the GNU C compiler... yes
checking whether gcc -std=gnu99 accepts -g... yes
checking for gcc -std=gnu99 option to accept ISO C89... none needed
configure: creating ./config.status
config.status: creating src/Makevars
** libs
g++ -I/usr/share/R/include -fpic -g -O2 -I. -g -
DHAVE_UINTPTR_T `pkg-config --cflags protobuf` -Wall -c display.cc -o
display.o
display.cc: In function ‘void mcount(char*, char*, uint32_t)’:
display.cc:96: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:111: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc: In function ‘SEXPREC* counter(SEXPREC*)’:
display.cc:143: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:150: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc: In function ‘void spill_to_reducer()’:
display.cc:216: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:256: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:259: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc: In function ‘SEXPREC* collect_buffer(SEXPREC*, SEXPREC*)’:
display.cc:295: warning: deprecated conversion from string constant to
‘char*’
display.cc:295: warning: deprecated conversion from string constant to
‘char*’
display.cc: In function ‘SEXPREC* readFromHadoop(uint32_t, int*)’:
display.cc:373: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:374: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc: In function ‘SEXPREC* readFromMem(void*, uint32_t)’:
display.cc:395: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:396: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc: In function ‘SEXPREC* persUnser(SEXPREC*)’:
display.cc:416: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:417: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc: In function ‘SEXPREC* dbgstr(SEXPREC*)’:
display.cc:427: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
display.cc:430: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope
make: *** [display.o] Error 1
chmod: cannot access `/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rhipe/libs/*': No
such file or directory
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'Rhipe'
** Removing '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rhipe'


It looks like the g++ compiler can't resolve the macro, but I'm not
sure as I'm definitely not a C++ guy. Can anybody suggest me what I'm
missing?

Thanks,

Masa Nakamura (masayang)

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Installation on Amazon EMR
parts:
You need the devel version of R. I.e built with shared library support.
The errors you get e.g.

display.cc:96: error: ‘protect’ was not declared in this scope
> display.cc:111: error: ‘unprotect’ was not declared in this scope

are because of the lack of the devel version of R

Cheers
Saptarshi

messages.author: c47f732bf0f6ef00
messages.subject: Re: Installation on Amazon EMR
parts:
Here is my bootstrap script for Amazon EMR. It installs Google
Protocol Buffer, updates R to latest version, then installs Rhipe.
This script worked on m1.small, m1.large, and m1.xlarge so far.

#! /bin/bash
set -e

export HADOOP=/home/hadoop

SOURCESLIST=sources.list
APTDIR=/etc/apt
CP=/bin/cp
SUDO=/usr/bin/sudo
APT=/usr/bin/apt-get
WGET=/usr/bin/wget
TAR=/bin/tar
MAKE=/usr/bin/make
R=/usr/bin/R
LDCONFIG=/sbin/ldconfig
CAT=/bin/cat
CHOWN=/bin/chown
LIBR=/usr/local/lib/R

PROTOBUF_PATH=http://protobuf.googlecode.com/files/
PROTOBUF=protobuf-2.3.0
PROTOBUF_SRC=$PROTOBUF.tar.gz

RHIPE_PATH=http://www.stat.purdue.edu/~sguha/rhipe/dn/
RHIPE_SRC=Rhipe_0.65.4.tar.gz

$CAT << EOF > $SOURCESLIST
deb http://http.us.debian.org/debian stable main contrib non-
free
deb http://security.debian.org lenny/updates main contrib non-
free
deb http://security.debian.org stable/updates main contrib non-
free
EOF

$SUDO $CP $SOURCESLIST $APTDIR/$SOURCESLIST
$SUDO $APT update
$SUDO $APT -y install r-base-dev
$SUDO $APT -y install pkg-config

$WGET $PROTOBUF_PATH$PROTOBUF_SRC
$TAR xvfz $PROTOBUF_SRC
cd $PROTOBUF && ./configure && $MAKE && $SUDO $MAKE install && $SUDO
$LDCONFIG
$WGET $RHIPE_PATH$RHIPE_SRC
$SUDO $CHOWN -R hadoop:hadoop $LIBR
$R CMD INSTALL $RHIPE_SRC

cd $HADOOP && $CAT << EOF >> .bashrc
export HADOOP=/home/hadoop
export HADOOP_BIN=/home/hadoop/bin
EOF

messages.subject: Re: Installation on Amazon EMR
parts:
Here is an update for the bootstrap.sh

I added biglm and multicore. I also found I needed to copy gfortran
library to /usr/lib so that rhbiglm.stream.hdfs works correctly.

#! /bin/bash
set -e

export HADOOP=/home/hadoop

SOURCESLIST=sources.list
APTDIR=/etc/apt
CP=/bin/cp
SUDO=/usr/bin/sudo
APT=/usr/bin/apt-get
WGET=/usr/bin/wget
TAR=/bin/tar
MAKE=/usr/bin/make
R=/usr/bin/R
LDCONFIG=/sbin/ldconfig
CAT=/bin/cat
CHOWN=/bin/chown
LIBR=/usr/local/lib/R

LIBDIR=/usr/lib
GFORTRAN=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/4.3/libgfortran*

PROTOBUF_PATH=http://protobuf.googlecode.com/files/
PROTOBUF=protobuf-2.3.0
PROTOBUF_SRC=$PROTOBUF.tar.gz

RHIPE_PATH=http://www.stat.purdue.edu/~sguha/rhipe/dn/
RHIPE_SRC=Rhipe_0.65.4.tar.gz

$CAT << EOF > $SOURCESLIST
deb http://http.us.debian.org/debian stable main contrib non-
free
deb http://security.debian.org lenny/updates main contrib non-
free
deb http://security.debian.org stable/updates main contrib non-
free
EOF

$SUDO $CP $SOURCESLIST $APTDIR/$SOURCESLIST
$SUDO $APT update
$SUDO $APT -y install r-base-dev
$SUDO $APT -y install pkg-config

$SUDO $APT -y install emacs ess

$SUDO $CP $GFORTRAN $LIBDIR

$WGET $PROTOBUF_PATH$PROTOBUF_SRC
$TAR xvfz $PROTOBUF_SRC
cd $PROTOBUF && ./configure && $MAKE && $SUDO $MAKE install && $SUDO
$LDCONFIG
$WGET $RHIPE_PATH$RHIPE_SRC
$SUDO $CHOWN -R hadoop:hadoop $LIBR
$R CMD INSTALL $RHIPE_SRC

cd $HADOOP && $CAT << EOF >> .bashrc
export HADOOP=/home/hadoop
export HADOOP_BIN=/home/hadoop/bin
EOF

cd $HADOOP && $CAT << EOF >> install.R
install.packages("biglm", repos="http://cran.r-project.org/")
install.packages("multicore", repos="http://cran.r-project.org/")
EOF
$R CMD BATCH install.R

>> #! /bin/bash

>> free
